references.name: long-view.jpeg
references.observed: Ordinary long view shows three blue-and-white pylons, three tower heads, paired stays, a continuous straight deck and approach trestles.

references.name: pylon.jpg
references.observed: Construction aerial shows all three pylons, unequal foundations on the gorge slopes, close-up leg profiles and the connection into the eastern approach.

references.interpretation: Dark pylon shadows connect to the ground-level lower legs near -1155, -605 and -55 m. High crowns are displaced laterally in the aerial image. The narrow cut on the southwest bank coincides with the PMTiles S62 tunnel endpoints.
